text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock C and D after sharp gains may have locked in profits too soon; I should base sell decisions on current portfolio needs and risk, not the comfort of realizing a win.","Buying more Stock E after its price fell taught me not to treat a decline as a bargain or let my original purchase price anchor me; each buy needs a fresh rationale.","My account moved through both gains and losses while I mostly held; with prices unpredictable, I should keep a deliberate allocation and avoid reacting to every monthly change."]}
